# Media fixtures

Every file encodes the same synthetic signal, generated by
[`scripts/fixtures/make_media_fixtures.py`](../../../scripts/fixtures/make_media_fixtures.py).
They contain no third-party recordings.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Duration | 2.0 s |
| Sample rate | 44 100 Hz |
| Channels | 2 (identical) |
| Signal | 440 Hz sine, amplitude 0.5 (−6.02 dBFS peak, −9.03 dBFS RMS) |
| Source | 16-bit PCM |

| File | Codec | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `sine440.wav` | PCM 16-bit LE | The source itself |
| `sine440.aiff` | PCM 16-bit BE | Lossless |
| `sine440.flac` | FLAC | Lossless |
| `sine440_alac.m4a` | ALAC in MP4 | Lossless |
| `sine440.mp3` | MP3, 192 kb/s | Lossy; encoder delay and padding |
| `sine440.ogg` | Vorbis, quality 5 | Lossy |
| `sine440_aac.m4a` | AAC-LC in MP4, 192 kb/s | Lossy; encoder priming |

Lossless files must reproduce the source exactly; lossy files are checked
against the expected values with codec-appropriate tolerances in
`crates/sonic-core/tests/formats.rs`.
